findings.correction: “Wipeng, come here. This is very important.”
findings.current: “Wipeng, come here. I have something very important to show you.”
findings.defect: Adds “to show you.” The source is only that the matter is very important, which is what makes Wipeng brace for a crisis.
findings.rationale: “아주 중요한 일이야” names a serious matter, not a reveal. “Show you” leaks that an object is coming and softens the embezzlement/Elder Council scare.
findings.source: “위팽, 이리 와 보게. 아주 중요한 일이야.”

findings.correction: What had he been eating growing up? Even after I smashed him dozens of times with the spear shaft, and even when I beat him one-sidedly from a mount, he endured it.
findings.current: No matter how many times I struck him with the shaft of my spear, or how one-sidedly I beat him while mounted on top of him, he endured it.
findings.defect: Drops “뭘 먹고 컸는지” and the quantity “수십 번.”
findings.rationale: The aside is Taekyung’s disbelief at Lee Seogeun’s toughness; “dozens of times” is a stated count, not generic repetition.
findings.source: 뭘 먹고 컸는지 창대로 수십 번을 후려쳐도, 마운트 자세에서 일방적으로 때려도 놈은 견뎌 냈다.

findings.correction: That was also why mages started at D-rank at the lowest.
findings.current: That was also why mages started at the lowest rank, D.
findings.defect: Reads as if D is the system’s lowest rank. The source is that D is the floor mages start from, because their mana is already high.
findings.rationale: The next lines still have E-ranks and Taekyung as F-rank. “The lowest rank, D” can invert the Hunter ranking mechanic the paragraph is explaining.
findings.source: 마법사들이 최하 D등급부터 시작하는 이유이기도 하다.

findings.correction: “It’s true, isn’t it? I know it’s rude, but just between us…?”
findings.current: “It’s true, isn’t it? I know it’s rude, but could you tell me just a little…?”
findings.defect: “저한테만 살짝” is a private, hush-hush confirmation, not a request to hear a bit more of the secret.
findings.rationale: Han Yeop already asked “사실이지요?” He wants a quiet confirmation for himself, not a partial explanation.

findings.correction: Honestly, from a modern man’s perspective, one was as bad as the other.
findings.current: Honestly, from a modern man’s perspective, one asshole was as bad as the other.
findings.defect: “그놈이 그놈이다” is “they’re the same,” without profanity. The draft adds a swear the source does not have here.
findings.rationale: Profanity should match the Korean. The following “지랄맞아” is the strong line; this idiom is not.
findings.source: 솔직히 현대인의 시선에서 바라보자면 그놈이 그놈이다.

findings.correction:
> **System**
>
> Fame has risen by 3 due to the influence of the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi rumor.
findings.current: > Fame has risen by 3 due to the influence of the **Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi** rumor.
findings.defect: This is a game System notice but has no `> **System**` heading.
findings.rationale: Each actual System panel must be a blockquote headed `> **System**`. The earlier rumor window is formatted that way; this one is not.

summary: Mostly close, but a few lines change setup cues, a Hunter-rank mechanism, a confirmation beat, and one System window’s format.
